faq.title: Common questions.
faq.a1: Top-level comments and replies both count toward your monthly quota. A thread with one parent comment and three replies = four comments toward your limit. We don't double-count edits or pinned messages.
faq.q2: Why does the Free plan show "Mostly positive" instead of exact percentages?
faq.a2: The qualitative label gives you the gist instantly. Exact percentages, hour-of-day trends, and full word and emoji rankings are part of the Pro plan, designed for creators who want to dig into the audience signal in detail. Free gives you the headline; Pro gives you the report.
faq.q3: Do I need a YouTube API key?
faq.a3: No. TubeMine uses our own API quota with the official YouTube Data API v3. Paste a public video URL and we handle the rest.

meta.title: Privacy · TubeMine
meta.description: Plain English about what TubeMine collects, why, and what we never do.

hero.title: Privacy.
hero.sub: Plain English about what we collect, why, and what we never do.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.p1: TubeMine collects the minimum needed to run the product. There are no marketing trackers, no enrichment pipelines, no behavioral profiles.
collect.b1_text: Your email address and display name when you sign in with Google. Nothing more.
collect.b2_text: Timestamps and comment counts per analysis. We use these to enforce your monthly cap and show your history.
collect.b3_text: Only at request time, only for rate limiting and abuse detection. Not stored beyond 24 hours.
collect.callout_text: the comment text itself, beyond a 30 day analysis cache that is purged automatically. The cache is needed so we can re-render your past results without re-querying YouTube.

never.title: What we never do
never.p1: This list is short on purpose. These promises are part of why TubeMine exists.
never.b1_text: We do not sell, rent, or share your data with any third party.
never.b2_text: The only analytics we use is Vercel Analytics, which is server-side, IP-anonymized, and cookie-free.
never.b3_text: No conversion tags, no remarketing audiences, no cross-site identifiers.
never.b4_text: We do not run canvas, font, or device-class fingerprinting.

youtube.title: YouTube data
youtube.p1: TubeMine queries the official YouTube Data API v3 server-side with our own API key. When you paste a YouTube URL, your browser sends that URL to TubeMine, then our server makes the API call to Google.
youtube.p2_strong: Your IP address is not sent to Google for analysis calls.
youtube.p2_text: Google sees our server's IP, not yours.
youtube.p3: Comments are public data, the same data anyone scrolling a YouTube video can see. TubeMine never accesses private channels, unlisted videos, or anything that requires owner authentication.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.b1_tail: It is required to keep you signed in.
cookies.p2: That is the entire cookie inventory. No tracking cookies, no marketing cookies, no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1_prefix: You can ask us to delete all the data we hold about you at any time. Email
rights.p1_tail: from the address on your account and we will purge within 7 days. You will receive a confirmation when the purge is complete.
rights.p2: If you are a resident of the EU, UK, or California, the rights granted by GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA apply. The mechanism is the same: one email.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.p1_prefix: If we change this policy in a way that affects what we collect or what we do with it, we will email every existing user at least
changes.p1_tail: the change applies. Non-material edits (typo fixes, link updates) are not announced but the "Last updated" date at the top of this page will change.

meta.description: What you agree to by using TubeMine.

hero.title: Terms of service.
hero.sub: What you agree to by using TubeMine.

asis.title: Provided as-is
asis.p1_tail: , without warranty of any kind, express or implied. We work hard to keep the service running, but we cannot guarantee 100 percent uptime, error-free analysis, or that any specific feature will keep working forever.
asis.p2: Use TubeMine to inform decisions, not to make irreversible ones. Sentiment models can be wrong. Comment counts can lag behind YouTube. Always sanity check before you publish a number.

youtube.title: YouTube data
youtube.p1_prefix: TubeMine uses the YouTube Data API v3 under
youtube.p1_link: Google's YouTube API Services Terms of Service
youtube.p1_tail: . By using TubeMine you are also bound by those terms with respect to YouTube data you see through the product.
youtube.p2: We access only public comment data via the official API. No unauthorized fetching, no private endpoints, no owner-only data.

use.title: Acceptable use
use.p1: A few non-negotiable rules. They exist to keep the service usable for everyone on a shared API quota.
use.b1_strong: No abuse of the shared API key.
use.b1_text: Do not script TubeMine to burn through quota for other users. Rate limits are enforced.
use.b2_strong: No automated harvesting behind our API.
use.b2_text: The product is for humans analyzing videos. Mass programmatic pipelines are not what this is for.
use.b3_text: You may use analysis results in your own reports, decks, and content. You may not repackage the underlying comment data and sell it.
use.b4_text: Your downstream use of insights from TubeMine, including any decisions based on them, is your responsibility.

suspension.title: Account suspension
suspension.p1: We can suspend accounts that abuse the service in any of the ways listed above, or that put the platform's stability or quota at risk. Suspension is not our first move.
suspension.p2_strong: We will email you before suspending
suspension.p2_tail: , explain what we observed, and give you a reasonable window to respond. Egregious cases (active exploitation, repeated quota exhaustion after a warning) may skip the warning.

pricing.title: Pricing changes
pricing.p1_prefix: If we change pricing or what is included at each tier, existing Pro subscribers get
pricing.p1_strong: at least 30 days notice by email
pricing.p1_tail: before the change applies to their billing. You can cancel any time in that window through the customer portal and pay the old rate for any remaining cycle.

law.p2: If a clause in these terms is found unenforceable in your jurisdiction, only that clause falls away. The rest still applies.
